newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 3.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia is following the case of a Saudi suspect in the al-Khobar bombing last year, the interior minister said.
- Arab National Bank announced a net profit of 251 million riyals for the first half of 1997.
- Crown Prince Abdullah discussed bilateral relations with Tajikistan's president in Jeddah.
- Iran's president said current conditions were encouraging regional states, including Saudi Arabia and Iran, to cooperate.
- The Amriya fertiliser company was set up in Egypt with a 35 percent Saudi share.
- Saudi American Bank and six other banks signed an 806 million riyal loan deal with Ibn Sina, a subsidiary of Saudi Basic Industries Corp (SABIC).
